|errata_history=This is the original printed text. The later errata versions are [[Through The Force Things You Will See (V) (Errata)]] (PC-E1) and [[Through The Force Things You Will See (V) (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2, the current text). The image is the Virtual Block 2 release-sheet slip, which shows this text; the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB2-L-throughtheforcethingsyouwillsee-pre.gif]]) shows the PC-E2 text and is on [[Through The Force Things You Will See (V) (Errata 2)]].
* '''Original''' (this page): text as given in the Virtual Block 2 release sheet (official text as of 7 December 2009), an Out Of Play Interrupt.<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock2">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock2.pdf#page=10 Virtual Block 2 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"), page 10, slip 156. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261022152656/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock2.pdf#page=10 Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Through The Force Things You Will See (V) (Errata)]]): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, through 11 January 2013) changed “than Force Pile” to “than in Force Pile”. The card list does not show the card type.<ref name="cl-1220_156">Players Committee website card list (VBlock2Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064711/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock2Type.html 21 July 2012] and, unchanged, [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111142857/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock2Type.html 11 January 2013] (Internet Archive)</ref>
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Through The Force Things You Will See (V) (Errata 2)]]): The Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) changed “If” to “Once per game, choose: if”, has “than Force Pile” again, and changed the card type from Out Of Play Interrupt to Lost Interrupt.<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=36, page 36. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=36 Internet Archive]</ref> The Players Committee announced this text on 19 November 2012, effective immediately, the day it removed the Out Of Play Interrupt subtype from the game (the post heads the card “LOST INTERRUPT”)<ref name="pcforum-p768283">Players Committee forum, Rules board, thread “Current Rulings/Errata” (t=36574), post by Aglets, 19 November 2012 ([https://web.archive.org/web/20150320030739/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/forums/viewtopic.php?f=871&t=36574#p768283 Internet Archive copy], captured 20 March 2015)</ref>.
